name: JARVIS
desc: An intelligent voice-based assistant built with Python that automates tasks, answers queries, and manages system operations using speech recognition and AI integration.

name: SecurePass
desc: SecurePass is a cybersecurity-focused web application that analyzes password strength in real time and estimates password cracking time. Built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, it provides security recommendations, requirement-based analysis, common-pattern detection, and a secure password generator while processing passwords locally in the browser.
